visualCharacteristics.purpose: top-of-page gradient pill with heading, text and CTA beside a circular photo

contentPattern.structure: One row, two cells: [heading + paragraph + CTA link] | [image]. Image cell may come first
cells: text: heading, body paragraph, one CTA link (rendered as button)

reuseGuidance: Use for a page-opening split hero with copy on one side and a photo on the other. For a full-bleed background photo with centered copy use hero-cta.
